plan:

GUARD: Allow only HTTP or HTTPS on default port; validate the initial public HTTP destination using `resolve_host`; reject every redirect response without following its Location value, regardless of whether that new destination also appears to be public; require status 200.

EFFECT: Return response body as `str` for status 200; raise `ValueError` for disallowed scheme/port, non-public initial destination, any redirect, or non-200 status.
